name: rivi-workspace
description: RIVI Workspace, an open-source workspace on Cloudflare Workers: Mail on Email Routing and Email Sending, Drive on R2, an AI Assistant over both on Workers AI, Calendar and Tasks linked with GitHub Issues (TanStack Start on Vite, D1, R2, KV, Better Auth)

scripts.fix: ultracite fix -A unicorn/catch-error-name -A typescript/consistent-type-definitions -A unicorn/prefer-dom-node-append -A unicorn/prefer-dom-node-dataset -A unicorn/prefer-query-selector -A unicorn/prefer-at -A unicorn/prefer-set-has -A unicorn/prefer-spread -A unicorn/prefer-bigint-literals -A unicorn/prefer-import-meta-properties
scripts.verify:static: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run format:check
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:static && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:check
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./seed/seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.setup: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run db:migrate:remote && pnpm run deploy:assets && wrangler deploy
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist .wrangler/deploy worker-configuration.d.ts tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.cloudflare.tsbuildinfo seed/seed.generated.sql

DB.description: The database: mailboxes, conversations, Drive's folders, calendars, tasks and sign-in.

KV.description: Throttles, the vacation responder and other small state. Name it `workspace-kv`: the two namespaces need different names.

PREVIOUS_ASSETS.description: An earlier build's files for seven days, so a tab left open survives a deploy. Name it `workspace-previous-assets`.

MAIL.description: Every message as it arrived (`.eml`) and every attachment.

DRIVE.description: The files in Drive, and the original and signed copy of every signing request.

SESSION_SECRET.description: **Required.** Signs the session cookies, the file links and every sealed value. Paste the output of `openssl rand -base64 48`; changing it later signs everyone out.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional, for the [Microsoft 365 import](https://github.com/rivi-software/workspace#microsoft-365-import): the Entra application's client id. Leave empty to keep the import off.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional, for the Microsoft 365 import: the Entra application's client secret.

MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.description: Optional, for the Microsoft 365 import: the directory (tenant) id. Empty lets any work account connect.

SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional, to send through [Amazon SES](https://github.com/rivi-software/workspace#amazon-ses): the IAM user's access key id. Leave empty to send through Cloudflare Email Sending.

SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional, for Amazon SES: the IAM user's secret access key.

APP_NAME.description: What the pages, the mails and the passkeys call the workspace.

APP_URL.description: The workspace's address, with `https://`: the project name above and your workers.dev subdomain (on **Workers & Pages**), such as `https://rivi-workspace.your-subdomain.workers.dev`, or a custom domain. Sign-in and passkeys work at this address only.

MAIL_DOMAIN.description: The domain every mailbox is an address on, such as `example.com`. It must be a zone on this account; onboard it in **Email Routing** and **Email Sending** after the deploy.

SES_REGION.description: Amazon SES's region, used only once the two SES secrets are set.

AI_PROVIDER.description: The Assistant's model: `workers-ai` (Workers AI through AI Gateway), `anthropic` (Claude through AI Gateway, which holds the key) or `mock` (no model).

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: The AI Gateway the Assistant calls through. `default` is created on the first call.

AI_TEXT_ANALYTICS.description: `on` sends the Assistant's prompts and answers to PostHog beside the counts; anything else sends counts only.

POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN.description: Optional: a PostHog project token for error tracking. Empty keeps PostHog off.

POSTHOG_HOST.description: PostHog's ingestion host, used only with a project token.
